source: FJC Integrated Database, Bankruptcy Petition NewSTATS Snapshots (BPNS), FY2008-present
fileFormat: Tab-delimited text with a header row of 87 SAS short names. Text zips: textfiles/cpbank08to17.zip, textfiles/cpbank18on.zip (one row per case per fiscal-year snapshot). datasets/*.zip are SAS .sas7bdat per year.
valueNote: Codebook lists y/n codes in lowercase; the FY2025 text file carries PRFILE as uppercase Y/N and D1FPRSE/JOINT as lowercase y/n. Compare case-insensitively (upper(col)).
note: Variable names and definitions verified against the Feb 2023 codebook. Hub bindings are confirmed where the codebook cites the form or line; inferred where the match is by meaning.

SNAPSHOT.meaning: Snapshot ending date (Sept 30 of snapshot year)

SNAPFILE.meaning: 1 if filed during the snapshot period

SNAPPEND.meaning: 1 if pending at end of snapshot period

SNAPCLOS.meaning: 1 if closed during the snapshot period

CASEKEY.meaning: BK + circuit + district + office + docket + generation + sequence

DISTRICT.lookup: table fjc_district (code, name) from codebook Appendix A; spokes/fjc/districts.json

CRNTCHP.meaning: Chapter on current record at end of snapshot; differs from ORGFLCHP after conversion

NTRDBT.meaning: b=Business c=Consumer o=Other; blank for Ch.15

D1CNTY.meaning: Debtor 1 county, 5-digit FIPS; 88888 outside home state, 99999 outside U.S.

D1FPRSE.meaning: y = debtor 1 pro se (no attorney) on most recent filing record; n = represented
D1FPRSE.mappingNote: pro se = absence of j:Attorney on B101; see also PayPetitionPreparerIndicator

FEESTS.meaning: c=installments completed i=paying installments p=paid in full u=not paid w=IFP waived n=missing

DBTRTYP.meaning: i=Individual p=Partnership u=Corporation/LLC/LLP n=Other (same codes as the hub)

NOB.codes: s Stockbroker, c Commodity Broker, b Clearing Bank, x Railroad, r Single Asset Real Estate, h Health Care Business, n Non-profit Organization, o Other, blank = consumer debt
NOB.caution: Code values diverge from the hub: in BkPetitionCodeLists.xsd o = Tax Exempt Entity and O = None of the above; in the IDB o = Other and n = Non-profit. Do not join case-insensitively. Before CM/ECF 4.1 (Jan 2011) a trailing t marked tax-exempt (e.g. ht).

PRFILE.meaning: y/n prior bankruptcy in previous 8 years, as reported on the petition

SMLLBUS.meaning: Whether a Chapter 11 debtor is a small business debtor under 11 U.S.C. 101(51D), as indicated on the petition
SMLLBUS.codes: y Yes, n No, blank missing; valid for Chapter 11 only

TOTASSTS.meaning: Real + personal property from Summary of Schedules

TOTLBLTS.meaning: Secured + priority + nonpriority, nulls as zero

NDSCHRGD.meaning: Sum of the six 'certain liabilities' lines (28 U.S.C. 159(c))

TOTDBT.meaning: Derived: DSCHRGD + NDSCHRGD; may differ from TOTLBLTS on null handling

AVGMNTHI.meaning: Schedule I line 12 combined monthly income

D1FDSP.meaning: Debtor 1 final disposition: A standard discharge, B hardship discharge, D n/a, E denied, F waived, G revoked, H-K dismissed (fee, info, abuse, other), L/M transfers

notCaptured: names, SSNs, addresses (only ZIP and county FIPS are published)
caveats: One record per case per snapshot, and snapshots overlap: the Sep 2026 release's rolling 06/30/2026 snapshot repeats 145,740 FY2025 cases from the 09/30/2025 year-end snapshot. The loaders dedupe on CASEKEY, keeping the latest SNAPSHOT (557,540 FY2025 new filings, not 703,280).
Schedule totals are required only for individual debtors with primarily consumer debt and are debtor-reported, not validated.
Debtor-level fields (ZIP, county, pro se) were corrected in Nov 2021 for FY2008-Jun 2021; re-download anything older.
TOTLBLTS treats nulls as zero; TOTDBT treats them as missing, so the two differ.
NOB code values differ from the petition schema: hub o = Tax Exempt Entity and O = None of the above; IDB o = Other, n = Non-profit. Never compare NOB case-insensitively against the hub.
y/n flags are not consistently cased: in FY2025 PRFILE is Y/N while JOINT and D1FPRSE are y/n. Compare with lower().

The bundled data/sample file is the first 20,000 FY2025 new-filing rows of cpbank18on.txt, not a random sample. Numbers from it are illustrative; load a full year before citing anything. Check count(*) on fjc_bk to see which is loaded.
DISTRICT is an FJC code (73 = California - Central, 3A = Florida - Middle); join table fjc_district for names (codebook Appendix A).
